The '''BWDL19 rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This variant of the [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]] was developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. A BWDL19 rifle was discovered in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of Dathomir during the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing virus outbreak]]<ref name="SWG:BR" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The BWDL19 rifle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The BWDL19 rifle was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
